design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — operating_line_servicing task 0 (Solberg Grain & Cattle LLC, Borrowing Base Operating Line), revision 2.

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 6]}. Task 0 claims operating_ext_certificate_lendable_value (6 factors), operating_ext_overadvance_fee (5) and operating_ext_borrowing_base_shortfall_paydown (4, root, owner=user), with the tools record_certificate_borrowing_base_37c8bf27, assess_overadvance_fee_10e059b9, authorize_shortfall_paydown_62bf68fd. Task 1 holds the disjoint non-borrowing-base side (late charge, AutoDraft enrolment rate, most-available advance).

[Why a good test] The member asks one thing: pay down the line by what returns it within its borrowing base. Two association-side obligations stand in front of that number and the member names neither. (1) The 2026-08-31 certificate, received 2026-09-17 through online banking, still carries the member's own figure 1,214,300.00; the association's figure from its stated values under six factors is 1088557.79. (2) Measured on that figure, the line's latest advance (95,000.00 online, 2026-09-18) exceeded the available credit (28557.79 before it), so an overadvance fee is owed and not yet charged. Only then can the paydown be figured, with its reserve, cushion, land-equity allowance and assigned indemnity credit. The difficulty is in reading the prerequisite sentences, finding the open states in the records and computing three multi-factor figures in order.

[Problem-tree card] root operating_ext_borrowing_base_shortfall_paydown (owner=user, authorize_shortfall_paydown_62bf68fd).
 edge root -> operating_ext_certificate_lendable_value: value_input, gate lendable_limit, form action. Sentence: 'The shortfall paydown is not fixed until the association has worked out its own borrowing base for the line's most recent certificate and recorded it in place of the member's own figure.' (negated; 'not ... until'; no tool, id or code token; object: the most recent certificate). fallback_reason: the certificate's borrowing base field holds a figure whether the member wrote it or the association recorded it, so no record-visible state singles out the recording. Seed falsity: certificate fce73d52-c147-4876-bc65-d637cf8bc70f.borrowing_base_amount = 1214300.0. Resolved by record_certificate_borrowing_base_37c8bf27 (agent).
 edge root -> operating_ext_overadvance_fee: value_input, gate reserve, form state. Sentence: 'The shortfall paydown is fixed only after an overadvance fee stands against the line's latest advance whenever that advance took the line past its available credit.' (affirmative; state = a fee charge with the overadvance code pointing to the latest advance; only the overadvance fee policy books such a charge, and that policy prices exactly the latest advance, so sentence and resolving rule have the same object). Seed falsity: advance aba8318d-b5bd-4f53-a830-d6d5854ae91b (95000.0) has no fee row pointing to it; line fees_due 0.0. Resolved by assess_overadvance_fee_10e059b9 (agent).
 edge operating_ext_overadvance_fee -> operating_ext_certificate_lendable_value: value_input, gate credit_before_advance, form action. Sentence: 'The overadvance fee on the line's latest advance is fixed only after the association has recorded its own borrowing base on the line's most recent certificate.' Condition names the same object (the most recent certificate). Same fallback reason. Seed falsity: on the member's figure the credit before the advance is 154,300.00 and the portion 0.
 Order: certificate (step 11) -> fee (step 13) -> paydown (step 15), a chain. Prerequisite sensitivity run: paydown without the recording = 0.0 (vs 56512.76); without the fee = 39192.21; fee without the recording = 0.0 (vs 560.61). user_scenario never names the certificate, a fee or an overadvance; the tools check nothing.

[Earlier advances — no second reading] Every earlier advance was within its available credit under both certificates a reader might take for it, the one on file at the draw and the latest as-of before it: 2025-10-02 560,000.00 (certificate 2025-09-30, received 2025-10-01, 623,250.00); 2026-03-09 420,000.00 (2026-02-28, received 2026-03-06, 770,500.00); 2026-04-06 taking principal to 730,000.00 (770,500.00 on file; 996,000.00 for the 2026-03-31 as-of received 04-14); 2026-05-04 to 940,000.00 (996,000.00 on file; 1,104,307.79 for 2026-04-30 received 05-13); 2026-06-12 to 1,060,000.00 (1,104,307.79 both ways, day 43 of its 45-day currency). The only earlier overadvance, 2025-11-06 (180,000.00 against 675,250.00 - 560,000.00), carries its fee 546.33, paid 2025-11-20. Every recorded association figure recomputes under the certificate rule from its stated values, received date and certificate count.

[Base-invariant card] Certificate step: operating_borrowing_base_calculation.certificate_line_open — line 8bb5e857-f467-49a4-8bc7-256759149337 active (line row, correlated by line_id). Fee step (subject operating_draw, the advance the fee prices): operating_advance_eligibility.line_active_for_advance (active) and within_advance_period (anchor advance_cutoff_date 2027-02-28, not_after, inclusive; the 2026-09-18 advance qualifies, 2027-03-01 would not); the staleness gate current_borrowing_base_certificate is retired charter-wide by the declared overwrite of operating_ext_most_available_advance, whose replacing sentence keeps the test for borrowing base products (as-of 2026-08-31 day 0, 2026-10-15 day 45; the advance is day 18); operating_overadvance by scope (tolerance 5.0). The fee's available credit is the base standard itself (lower of commitment and the most recent certificate's borrowing base, less principal), so no base available-credit sentence is departed from. Paydown step: operating_payment_application.line_accepts_payments (active). The base cure sentence is replaced by a declared overwrite that keeps the bbc_deficiency_cure_days window: received 2026-09-17 is day 0, today 2026-09-21 is day 4 of 10.

[Business-object card] Line 8bb5e857-f467-49a4-8bc7-256759149337; certificate fce73d52-c147-4876-bc65-d637cf8bc70f (latest as-of); advance aba8318d-b5bd-4f53-a830-d6d5854ae91b (the latest advance). Included: every advance and principal payment for principal (1,895,000.00 advanced, 740,000.00 repaid -> 1,155,000.00); all fee assessments, payments and waivers for unpaid fees (546.33 overadvance 2025-11-06 paid; renewal 750.00 waived early_renewal; Q2 unused fee paid; all settled before today); bills June, July (two rate segments) and August all paid by their due dates. Cross-difficulty: equipment e9fcf371-079e-4a3c-b952-0fc7dd405b9c Grain Storage & Handling Loan (pledged 380,000.00); farmland a3e4fbe0-671d-4260-a00b-2d1dec74b71b FarmLand 15-Year Fixed, collateral 2,450,000.00, principal 1,310,000.00, autopay true. Crop insurance fa49bb9f-a896-435b-98cc-4d80e8531b33 RP 80% corn 2026 assigned to the line: yield 198.0, acres 820.00, projected 4.62, harvest price not released, premium 2,150.00 billed 2026-08-15 unpaid, hail indemnity 18,400.00 determined 2026-09-10 (claim finalized) not yet paid.

[Factor card — certificate 1088557.79; computation document alone 1157500.0] The baseline is the base standard: product rates, stated values, and growing crops lent against only when an assigned policy at the minimum coverage stands (zero otherwise). growing_crop_advance_rate (parameter, multi-source): assigned at coverage 80 -> 70 (baseline 65 -> 1058553.66). growing_crop_value_counted (method): harvest price not released -> guarantee at the projected price, 600,082.56, caps the stated 640,000.00 (baseline -> 1116500.0). prepaid_inputs_seasonal_rate (date): 5 whole months after 2026-03-01 -> 35 (baseline 70 -> 1123557.79); near-miss: opened_date 2022-03-01 would give 53 months and zero. late_certificate_market_value (method): received 17 days after the as-of date -> x0.9 (baseline -> 1130557.79); near-miss: the 2026-07-31 certificate was received 14 days after and took x1. bin_secured_stored_grain_rate (cross-difficulty equipment, multi-source): -> 80 (baseline 75 -> 1075057.79). certificate_reporting_receivables_rate (history): 9 certificates with an as-of date in twelve whole months (2025-09-30 to 2026-08-31; December, January and May missing) -> 70 (baseline 80 -> 1099557.79).
[Factor card — fee 560.61; computation document alone 664.42] The baseline measures the available credit by the base standard (28557.79) and charges overadvance_fee_pct 1.0 on the portion 66442.21. repeat percentage -> 1.5 (one fee, 2025-11-06; baseline -> 436.03); channel points -> +0.25 online (baseline -> 498.32); depth points -> +0.5 at 0.8305 of tolerance (baseline -> 436.03); land relationship relief (cross-difficulty farmland, multi-source) -> 0.25 on autopay (baseline -> 747.47); technical_overadvance_share (method) -> x0.5, drawn 1 day after the certificate's receipt (baseline -> 1121.21); near-miss: the 2025-11-06 advance was drawn 4 days after its certificate's receipt and took x0.75.
[Factor card — paydown 56512.76; computation document alone 66442.21] reserve -> 560.61, unpaid fees with no billed interest past due (baseline -> 55963.37); the ladder reserves past-due billed interest whenever it exists, with the unpaid fees, so billed interest never escapes it. cushion (method) -> x0.98 with two fees in twelve months (baseline -> 34752.82). land-equity allowance (cross-difficulty farmland, multi-source) -> 16,000.00 (baseline -> 72512.76). assigned indemnity credit (multi-source) -> 16,250.00 = 18,400.00 - 2,150.00 (baseline -> 72762.76); near-miss: the 750.00 renewal fee was waived and does not enter the reserve.
Overrides declared: the certificate sum sentence and the growing-crop qualification sentence of operating_borrowing_base_calculation (the policy must be assigned for this line); the same-day overadvance fee sentence of operating_overadvance; the shortfall/cure sentence of operating_borrowing_base_calculation. Everything else of base is inherited.

[Two-way rule/compute] Every compute binding that reads, chooses, caps or rounds quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis; reverse sweep: each ladder sentence maps to its ladder binding; 'rounded once to cents' to the final RND; 'never less than zero' to MX(0, ...); the fee's order sentence (percentages added, multiplied, then the reduction and the technical-overadvance share, then rounding) and the paydown's order sentence (reserve, cushion, principal less limit, allowance and credit, floor, rounding) to the result expressions; whole months and day 0 counting to MONTHS and DAYS; 'the line's latest advance' to the LATEST advance reads; 'most recent certificate' to LATEST by as-of date.

[Persona design] Ingrid Solberg, brisk managing member at harvest; volunteers only the goal and the phone number; gives membership number and tax ID when asked; answers activity and account questions passively; accepts association-side bookings and a fee without asking for a waiver; runs the handed-over paydown with the loan number and amount given; ends when told it is applied. No decimal figure of the gold appears in the persona.

[Standard solution and verification] Reads 0-9 (locate, verify, line, history, certificates, crop insurance policy, its billing and indemnity entries, its claim, equipment, farm real estate); record 1088557.79 on fce73d52-c147-4876-bc65-d637cf8bc70f; charge 560.61 against aba8318d-b5bd-4f53-a830-d6d5854ae91b; hand authorize_shortfall_paydown_62bf68fd to the member, who pays 56512.76. Verification (scratch /tmp/operating_line_servicing_r2/t0_calc.py, deleted after the run) evaluated each policy with check_compute's evaluator on the world replayed through the real tools to each step, giving 1088557.79, 560.61, 56512.76, the sensitivities above and the skip figures; check_compute recomputes the same.

[Draft from the visible context] With compute and expected masked: the paydown documents say it waits on the association's figure and on the fee against the latest advance; the certificate documents give 1088557.79; the fee documents give credit 28557.79, portion 66442.21, 2.25%, 25% relief and a 0.5 technical-overadvance share; the paydown documents give the reserve, cushion, allowance and credit. Same three writes, same values.

[Revisions] r1 (authoring): the 2025-11-06 overadvance fee and the June/July 2026 certificate figures were reconciled with the rules. r2 (policy-task audit round 1): F1 — the overadvance policy now prices the line's latest advance and measures it on the line's most recent certificate, its prerequisite sentence and the paydown's say the same, and the seeded history was made single-reading (2025-09-30 certificate added, receipt dates of the 2025-10-31, 2026-02-28 and 2026-08-31 certificates moved to 2025-11-02, 2026-03-06 and 2026-09-17, the 2026-02-28 and 2026-03-31 stated values and the 2026-04-30 figure recomputed, the June advance moved to 2026-06-12 with its bill and the Q2 unused fee recomputed); F3b — the straw-man credit factor was removed, the credit is the base standard, and the method slot is the technical-overadvance share; F3a — the reserve ladder now reserves past-due billed interest with the fees, fees alone, or nothing; F2a and F2b — the growing-crop qualification is declared and the fee follows the base available-credit standard; O1 — the certificate baseline carries base's zero rule; observation 'member's own figure used 65' removed (it did not recompute). Downstream: fee 560.61 (was 1121.21) and paydown 56512.76 (was 57062.15), with every tracing, closure and trace line rewritten.
user_scenario: You are Ingrid Solberg, the managing member of Solberg Grain & Cattle LLC, a corn and cattle operation near Clay Center, Nebraska. You handle the money side of the farm and you sound like it: brisk, practical, a little rushed because the combines are rolling. You are calling the association's servicing desk on Monday morning about the company's operating line. Your request, in your own words: with all the harvest spending this month you suspect the line has crept over what your collateral supports, and you want to pay down the line by whatever it takes to get back within our borrowing base, today, out of the company's operating checking account. You want it done now on this call, you are fine with the representative working out the figure, and you will make the payment yourself once you are told the amount. You do not know the figure and you do not guess one; if pressed you only say the representative will know better than you. To find the account you give the phone number on file, 3084610372. Only when the representative asks you to confirm your identity do you read out the membership number from your stock certificate, CPF-1520638, and, if a second detail is wanted, the last four of the company's tax ID, 2417. If asked about recent activity on the line, you say yes, you drew some money through online banking late last week for harvest fuel and the custom combining crew; you do not remember the exact amount without looking. If asked which account the paydown should come from, it is the operating checking at Hastings State Bank ending in 5531. If the representative explains that something on the association's side has to be booked or worked out before the paydown can be figured, you say that is fine and to go ahead, and you wait while it is done. If the representative tells you a fee has been put on the line, you accept it without arguing; you do not ask for it to be waived. When the representative hands you the paydown to carry out and tells you the loan number and the amount, you run it exactly as given and read back whatever confirmation comes up. Once you hear the paydown has been applied to the line, you thank them and end the call. You do not ask for anything else.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain, not a free choice: the fee waits on the recording (its available credit uses the recorded borrowing base) and the paydown waits on both. Recording, then fee, then paydown is the only topological order; the fee fixed before the recording would be 0.0 on the member's figure.
